revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_008
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 8, BLUE rank, SECOND medal in the blue pair. Based on the Chinese title concept "这地球，这世界，全是您走出来的！" (the whole world was walked out by you). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot style: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 8 pose: the foot mascot proudly standing on a tiny stylized globe/map sphere, with dotted walking path loops and tiny footprint marks circling around it, looking triumphant and silly. Keep the foot as the main character.
Medal border: BLUE rank, SECOND blue medal. Use a refined cobalt and sky-blue enamel circular border with silver trim, blue gems, elegant top crest, and clearly visible symmetrical blue side wings / feather-like blue-silver wings extending outward from the circle. This must be more ornate than tier 7 and obviously the upgraded second medal of the blue pair. No purple, orange, or gold rank color dominance.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals and previous anthropomorphic foot candidates: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central foot mascot fully inside circular core, side wings visible but inside safe margins.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, triumphant and funny.
Color palette: cobalt blue and sky blue border, silver trim, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, small blue globe accents; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: include blue side wings, include feather-like blue-silver wings, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold; second medal of each color pair has wings
wing_rule: second medal in color pair has wings
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
